Here is a colour-mixing problem. Answer with a single colour word and nothing else.
Problem: A potion changes colour each time it is stirred, according to these rules:
A green potion turns purple when stirred.
A purple potion turns orange when stirred.
An orange potion turns black when stirred.
A black potion turns orange when stirred.
A white potion turns blue when stirred.
A red potion turns white when stirred.
A brown potion turns blue when stirred.
A gray potion turns purple when stirred.
A blue potion turns purple when stirred.
A gold potion turns red when stirred.
The potion starts out green.
You stir the potion twice.
What colour is the potion at the end?
